entry.title: New: BILL034(24) (Honolulu) — PUBLISH
entry.content:
RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAXATION.

Increases the assessed value threshold for properties to be classified as Residential A. Amends valuation tiers for properties classified as Residential A and transient vacation. Effective upon approval and applies to tax years beginning July 1, 2027, and thereafter.

Latest action: Final reading notice published in the Honolulu Star-Advertiser.
